# DataSync

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/datasync@v1.61.4` · last audited 2026-10-07 (`bfdb308be`)

### Known gaps

- LocationUri schemes "object-storage://" and "azure-blob://" violate the published LocationUri pattern, but neither the pinned SDK nor botocore/AWS docs say what real AWS returns for these two types; not changed to a guessed scheme.
- LocationUri scheme "fsxl://" for FSx Lustre was chosen by analogy with the documented FSx OpenZFS "fsxz://"; matches the published pattern but is unconfirmed against real output.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- AgentListEntry.Platform (agent software Version) is never emitted: it describes the real agent appliance, and CreateAgent has no input to source it from.
- ManagedSecretConfig stays absent from DescribeLocation*: AWS auto-provisions a service-owned Secrets Manager secret for plaintext credentials, so there is no SecretArn to honestly report.
- DescribeTask ErrorCode/ErrorDetail (UNAVAILABLE tasks) and Source/DestinationNetworkInterfaceArns are never emitted: they come from real agent connectivity failures and ENIs provisioned during real transfers.

### Deferred

- StorageSystem / DiscoveryJob / TaskReport-as-standalone-ops: not present in aws-sdk-go-v2/service/datasync v1.59.2 at all (re-verified this sweep: full api_op_*.go listing has no such ops -- grepped for storagesystem/discoveryjob/taskreport case-insensitively across services/datasync/*.go, zero matches). TaskReportConfig itself IS a real member of CreateTaskInput/UpdateTaskInput/DescribeTaskOutput and is now modeled (see Task family fix) -- it's a configuration blob on the task, not a standalone set of ops. The family mentioned in the audit brief (dedicated StorageSystem/DiscoveryJob CRUD + Start/Stop/DescribeDiscoveryJob ops) does not exist in the pinned SDK.
